name: smwgraphics-super-princess-peach-vibe-blocks
title: Super Princess Peach - Vibe Blocks
description:
Unused blocks that come from Super Princess Peach, they are blocks that can act as foreground decorations, but with asm they can have other uses.

Rykon-V73 Edit: Only the yellow block is a sprite that acts as a NSMB propeller block letting the player float, the other 2 will have to have custom asm to work as desired, blue block has a tear animation.
